Found by the pre-cutover enforcement audit (2026-08-09) and INDEPENDENTLY CONFIRMED by the controller this session (direct file inspection + the subagent's own unblocked rm -rf/find as live proof). This is a dev-environment agent-safety hole, NOT a core01 service defect — severity is "agents working in this repo are unguarded," not "the cutover is unsafe." Separated from the cutover blockers deliberately.

## Confirmed directly
- open-brain/.claude/settings.json has NO `permissions` block (verified: `has permissions key: False`).
- open-brain/.claude/settings.local.json ALLOWS `Bash(find:*)` (and bun/echo/tsc).
- open-brain/_ob/ does not exist; _ob/bin/ob-gate is MISSING.
- open-brain registers only its repo-specific hooks (design-lookup-gate, pr-body-gate, merge-gate, hydration-stamp, design-contract) via .claude/hooks/. The Development-wide safety gates are registered ONLY in /Volumes/ThunderBolt/Development/.claude/settings.json as `${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/_ob/bin/ob-gate <gate>`.

## The mechanism
When open-brain is CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, `${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/_ob/bin/ob-gate` resolves to open-brain/_ob/bin/ob-gate — missing. The shell returns 127, and PreToolUse treats any non-2 exit as ALLOW, so the gate fails OPEN. ob-gate's own header says it "FAILS CLOSED, DELIBERATELY / converts every breakage into exit 2" — it cannot, because the file that would do that is the missing one. The exact failure mode ob-gate exists to prevent, reproduced one level up. Root-scope invocation blocks correctly (gate LOGIC is fine); only reachability from open-brain is broken.

## Live proof
The audit subagent ran `find`, `grep`, and `rm -rf` (on its own scratch) UNBLOCKED in this repo. fast-tools-gate and destructive-delete-gate are claimed controls (AGENTS.md, repo CLAUDE.md) that do not fire here.

## Also confirmed by the same audit (repo-specific gates ARE sound)
pr-body-gate, merge-gate, design-lookup-gate, contract-parity CI, PR-body CI all reject their crafted violations correctly. merge-gate positive control (PR #673, receipt sha == head) exits 0 naming (a)+(b). Those are working.

Add a done-means check that constructs a destructive-delete and a fast-tool call and asserts each is REFUSED in this repo (the enforcement-auditor pattern), so this can't silently regress. Note there may be a SEPARATE merge-gate concern (audit claimed `gh api -X PUT .../merge` and `git push HEAD:main` bypass it) — I have NOT independently confirmed that one; see #679-followup, do not assume.
